capabilities: Generate briefing scripts from notes with AI providers (Gemini, Grok, OpenAI, Claude) in several styles and languages
Convert scripts to audio with TTS engines (Edge TTS, Gemini TTS, OpenAI TTS, ElevenLabs)
Upload audio to Google Drive and create public sharing links
Embed the audio at the bottom of the note as an HTML player, Markdown link, or direct URL
disambiguation: Not a voice recorder; it generates spoken briefings from existing note text.
extras: Manifest description warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop-only. Part of the README (Google Drive setup and submission checklist) is written in Korean. Several providers require paid accounts or have free tiers; Edge TTS and Gemini are presented as free options.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert note content into spoken audio summaries or share them as playable links.

relations.evidence: Edge TTS - Free local Microsoft voices (edge-tts CLI)
TTS by Microsoft Edge TTS and ElevenLabs
AI powered by Google Gemini, XAI, OpenAI, and Anthropic
OpenAI script and speech APIs, when OpenAI is selected

requires.name: AI provider (Gemini, xAI, OpenAI, or Anthropic)
Edge TTS CLI for the free TTS option
ElevenLabs or Google account depending on chosen engine/sharing
TTS provider key (ElevenLabs, Gemini, or OpenAI)

summary: Turns notes into 1-2 minute AI-generated audio briefings using LLM script writing, text-to-speech engines, and optional Google Drive sharing.
